title: Elastic Stack 8.19.21 released
summary: Read about the updates and bug fixes that have been included in this release.
body_markdown:
Version 8.19.21 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you[upgrade to this latest version](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/upgrade) . We recommend 8.19.21 over the previous versions 8.19.21


For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.


The 8.19.21 release contains fixes for potential security vulnerabilities. Please see our[security announcement](https://discuss.elastic.co/c/announcements/security-announcements/31) for more details
